concepts.gloss_en: Expositions/explanations of the Torah (the aspect of 'panim', drawn down by the leader/Moshe)
Expositions AND expounded homilies of the Torah — a coordinated construct adding 'derushei'; may or may not be the identical referent as beurei ha-Torah

members.note: adds a second construct head (דרושי) coordinated with באורי; equated with 'penei Hashem' here. Different head-set — under-merge per rules 1 & 4

concepts.gloss_en: Drawing down/channeling the expositions of the Torah — the action, not the expositions themselves

members.note: action (המשכה) about באורי התורה; per rule 4 an action about X ≠ X (cf. בנין בית המקדש ≠ בית המקדש)

notes: All three occur in lm1:20 and are closely related, but kept separate: one is the core noun, one adds a coordinated construct head (דרושי), and one names the act of drawing them down. Human may choose to fold #2 into #1 if 'derushei' is deemed a mere expansion.
